# Studio 87

> Studio 87 makes free, open source music production software: synth and effect plugins (VST3 and standalone), DJ tools, hardware synth controller plugins and Korg logue units. Linux first, with Windows and macOS builds for many. Built with JUCE and C++. Everything is free to use; to change or build on it, fork it on GitHub. Donations are welcome on Ko-fi.

Website: https://speakingcolors.github.io/
Source code and releases: https://github.com/SpeakingColors
Support: https://ko-fi.com/studio87

## Synths

Free open source synth plugins for bass, leads, supersaws and wavetables.

- [SupurrSaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/supurrrsaw-vst/): SupurrSaw: free open source supersaw, hoover and acid synth. VST3 plugin and standalone for Linux, Windows and macOS. JP-8000 style supersaw, built-in FX, presets.
- [PurrOne](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrone/): PurrOne: free open source mono synth plugin with a thick, smooth sound for bass and lead. VST3 and standalone, Linux first, Windows and macOS targeted. (test build)
- [JPurrr-8000](https://speakingcolors.github.io/jpurrr-8000/): Free open source JP-8000 style supersaw synth for trance (VST3 and standalone). (test build)
- [Whiskerwave](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskerwave-vst/): Free open source wavetable synth VST3 for Linux: morphing wavetable oscillators, layered voices, mod matrix, built-in FX, sample your own hardware into wavetables. CC0 waves.

## Compressors, limiters and EQ

Compressors, limiters, transient shaping and EQ in classic and new styles.

- [Apurrr2500](https://speakingcolors.github.io/apurrr2500/): Free open source bus compressor plugin (VST3) for Linux, Windows and macOS. (test build)
- [FetlinePounce](https://speakingcolors.github.io/fetlinepounce/): Free open source FET compressor plugin in the style of the 1176 (VST3) for Linux, Windows and macOS. (test build)
- [LapCat2A](https://speakingcolors.github.io/lapcat2a/): Free open source optical compressor and limiter plugin in the LA-2A style (VST3). (test build)
- [Furchild](https://speakingcolors.github.io/furchild/): Free open source variable-mu tube compressor plugin in the Fairchild style (VST3). (test build)
- [Purrrstressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrrstressor/): Free open source compressor plugin in the Distressor style (VST3) for Linux, Windows and macOS. (test build)
- [PunchPaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/punchpaw/): Free open source kick and drum limiter plugin (VST3) for Linux, Windows and macOS. (test build)
- [Clawpressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/clawpressor-vst/): Free open source multiband compressor and limiter VST3 for Linux. Up to 4 bands, per band limiter, drawable rhythmic gain patterns, scopes. Defaults for house, UK hardcore and hardstyle. (test build)
- [MultiPaw Compressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/multipawcompressor/): Free open source multiband compressor and limiter with multiband sidechain in one plugin (VST3), Linux first. Test build. (test build)
- [ClawShaper](https://speakingcolors.github.io/clawshaper/): Multiband transient shaper with limiter (VST3). (test build)
- [Pawltec](https://speakingcolors.github.io/pawltec/): Free open source tube program EQ plugin in the Pultec style (VST3) for Linux, Windows and macOS. (test build)
- [CatRack](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catrack/): Channel strip plugin with 28 built-in units from the Studio 87 effects, in one all-in-one plugin. (test build)

## Saturation, distortion and tone

Warmth, grit, bass weight and loudness.

- [Cat Crusher](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catcrusher-vst/): Free open source distortion, compressor and filter plugin (VST3 and standalone) for Linux. Tube, fold and hard clip shapers, multimode filter, live displays. Early. (test build)
- [Fat Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/fatcat/): Free open source saturator (VST3 and standalone) for Linux, macOS and Windows that keeps the dynamics of your sound. Drive, fuzz, colour, stereo, mix. (test build)
- [Meowbass](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowbass/): Free open source psychoacoustic bass enhancer (VST3 and standalone) for Linux: makes harmonics from the bass so small speakers suggest deep bass. Early. (test build)
- [Meowximizer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowximizer/): Free open source sonic enhancer, bass enhancer and exciter (VST3 and standalone) for Linux. Three bands, OTT-style squeeze, saturation and output limiter. Early. (test build)

## Space, rhythm and special effects

Reverb, ducking, volume shaping, phase fixing and freeze effects.

- [shimmerstuff](https://speakingcolors.github.io/shimmerstuff/): Shimmer reverb and shimmer delay plugin (VST3 and standalone) for Linux, Windows and macOS, with a routing view. Plate, hall, shimmer and velvet reverbs. By Studio 87. (test build)
- [Cat Spacer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catspacer/): Free open source spectral sidechain ducker (VST3 and standalone) for Linux: the sidechain spectrum carves gaps in the main signal so a lead and a vocal or kick share the mix. 64 bands. (test build)
- [Scaredy Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scaredy-cat/): Free open source volume shaper plugin (VST3 and standalone): three bands with drawn volume curves for kick pumps, trance gates and chops. Tempo synced. (test build)
- [phasepaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/phasepaw/): Phase alignment plugin for kick and bass, for better mono compatibility. Free, open source, VST3.
- [Hairball](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hairball/): Hairball: free open source grain-based audio freeze and transform plugin (VST3, instrument and FX) for dance, house, UK hardcore and hardstyle. Linux first. (test build)

## DJ and creative tools

Scratch, DJ decks, sample tools and generators.

- [Scratch Cat FX](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scratchcatfx-vst/): Scratch effect plugin (VST3 and standalone): scratch, brake and backspin audio from your DAW, with EQ, colour and a 3 slot FX chain. Early, free and open source. (test build)
- [Scratch Cat Duo](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scratchcatduo-vst/): Two DJ decks and a mixer in one plugin (VST3 and standalone). Free and open source, Linux first. Hot cues, loops, sampler, pad FX, EQ and kill switches. (test build)
- [Stretch Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/stretch-cat-vst/): Sampler with time stretch (VST3 and standalone): change speed without changing pitch, or pitch without changing speed. Early, free and open source. (test build)
- [Copycat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/copycat-vst/): Sound analyser plugin (VST3 and standalone): play a sound through it and it estimates note, key, chord, tempo, oscillator shape, voices, filter and envelope to help rebuild it. Early. (test build)
- [Kick Kitten](https://speakingcolors.github.io/kickkitten/): Free open source trance kick maker (VST3 and standalone). (test build)
- [AI Purrformer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/ai-purrformer/): Free open source AI singing voice tool for Linux: sing badly, get a better voice back, on time and in key. Part of the Studio 87 cat plugin suite.

## Studio tools and apps

Editors, analysers, sample manager, mixer and the Gear Updater launcher.

- [Meowcorder](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowcorder/): Meowcorder: work in progress audio editor and recorder by Studio 87. (test build)
- [Purrfect Cut](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrfect-cut/): Audio editor and VST plugin from one install (Linux, Windows, macOS): cut, trim, fade, normalise, reverse, plus Auto-Tune style pitch pages for voices and leads. Free and open source. (test build)
- [CATalog](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catalog/): Sample manager for your studio (standalone and VST3): scan sample folders, search, tag, rate, favourite and preview. Early, free and open source. (test build)
- [Whisker Scope](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskerscope/): Whisker Scope: free open source analyser plugin (VST3 and standalone): scope, spectrum and frequency analyzer from Studio 87. (test build)
- [WhiskerMix](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskermix/): TotalMix-style mixer and studio hub for Linux: RME Digiface USB control, MIDI hub, Pulse 16 support and built-in FX. Design phase. (test build)
- [Gear Updater](https://speakingcolors.github.io/gearupdater/): Launcher for Studio 87 software: browse, download, install and update every plugin and app in one place, no GitHub hunting. (test build)
- [Stardrift TV Launcher](https://speakingcolors.github.io/stardrifttvlauncher/): Couldn't find a TV Launcher I like, so I made one.

## Hardware controller plugins

Control your hardware synths from your DAW on Linux.

- [Novation Peak controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/linux-peak-controller/): Controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Novation Peak, built for Linux first: sends and receives CC and NRPN messages. Early build. (test build)
- [Novation UltraNova controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/linux-ultranova-controller/): Controller plugin for the Novation UltraNova and MiniNova on Linux, with MIDI implementation notes (CC and NRPN maps). (test build)
- [Korg minilogue xd controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/minilogue-xd-controller/): MIDI controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Korg minilogue xd: sends and receives its CC messages from your DAW. Early build. (test build)
- [Korg drumlogue controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/drumlogue-linux-controller/): Controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Korg drumlogue on Linux: sends and receives CC messages from your DAW. Early build. (test build)
- [Behringer JT-4000 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/jt4000-vst/): MIDI controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Behringer JT-4000 (JT-4000 Micro): sends and receives its CC messages from your DAW. Early build. (test build)
- [Behringer PRO VS Mini controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/provsmini-vst/): Controller plugin for the Behringer PRO VS Mini vector synthesizer on Linux. Planning stage.
- [Yamaha MODX M controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/modxm-controller-vst/): MIDI controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Yamaha MODX M: sends and receives its CC messages from your DAW. Early build. (test build)
- [MX400 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/mx400-vst-linux/): Controller plugin for the MX400 on Linux. Early work in progress. (test build)
- [M-VAVE FM-1 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/mwave-fm1-linux-vst/): Controller plugin for the M-VAVE FM-1 on Linux. Early work in progress.
- [Modal Cobalt8M controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/cobalt8m-controller-vst/): MIDI controller plugin (VST3 and standalone) for the Modal Cobalt8M: sends and receives its CC messages from your DAW. Early build. (test build)
- [Behringer TD-3-MO controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/td3mo-vst/): Controller and sequencer companion plugin for the Behringer TD-3-MO bass line synth on Linux, with an offline recipe book and 16 step pattern roll. (test build)
- [Behringer Pro-1 patch book](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catpro1/): Patch book and global-settings tool for the Behringer Pro-1 on Linux, with an offline recipe book that draws the Pro-1 front panel. (test build)

## Korg minilogue xd and drumlogue units

Oscillator and effect units for the Korg minilogue xd and drumlogue.

- [MegaSaw XD](https://speakingcolors.github.io/megasaw-xd/): Bigger SuperSaw oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd: two JP-8000 style layers, up to 11 voices each, saw, square, pulse, glass or Ah vocal waves. Free.
- [hypersaw-xd](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hypersaw-xd/): Three layers of JP-8000 style supersaw in one oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd: 7 detuned voices per layer, saw, square, glass and Ah vocal waves. (test build)
- [sawwiden-xd](https://speakingcolors.github.io/sawwiden-xd/): Mono-safe stereo widener unit for the Korg minilogue xd that spreads supersaws without phasing; bass stays centered. (test build)
- [hypersaw-drumlogue](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hypersaw-drumlogue/): JP-8000 style supersaw oscillator for the Korg drumlogue. Early work in progress.
- [HyperSawX](https://speakingcolors.github.io/super-duper-stuff/): Free JP-8000 style SuperSaw user oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd: 15 detuned saws, sub oscillator, analog-style drift and vibrato.

## For developers

Shared building blocks and the Claude skills used to make this software.

- [cat-ui](https://speakingcolors.github.io/cat-ui/): Shared JUCE look and feel for the Studio 87 cat plugins: wood side cheeks, knobs, header, resizable from every corner and edge with locked aspect ratio.
- [claude-skills](https://speakingcolors.github.io/claude-skills/): The Claude skills I made for building Studio 87 software, free to reuse. (test build)
